attributes.source_discrepancy: The printed 0.84 is above both GENA-LM values BEND prints in its main results table, GENA-LM BERT 0.76 and GENA-LM BigBird 0.82, so it is not the best result among the models of this family as the caption's rule states. Reviewed on 2026-11-16 against two renditions of BEND: the ICLR 2024 proceedings PDF this store pins as evidence-expansion-bend-final-f709b6be, and the arXiv rendition arXiv:2311.12570 retrieved on 2026-11-16 (SHA-256 bfb40a6afe8028a52ea6c810bba3729510f1e768cc1288026b46e458df2d4ec9). Both print 0.76 and 0.82, and no subset of the GENA-LM family reproduces all seven printed cells of this row, while the DNABERT, HyenaDNA and Nucleotide Transformer rows each have one that does. The printed value stands as printed and is not corrected. The review added an evidence concern to phylogpn-2025 naming this result, so it is withheld from automatic comparison until the upstream value is settled.
